## IGramstaxPollingDeployOptions type

Polling deploy branch of `optionsDeploy`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IGramstaxPollingDeployOptions = {
    maxRetries?: number;
};
```

## Remarks

Only meaningful when `deploy` is `polling`<!-- -->. Carries the retry budget that used to live at the root `pollingMaxRetries` field.

## Example


```typescript
const polling: IGramstaxPollingDeployOptions = {maxRetries: 5}
```
